production_safety.operational_data: No existing operational rows migrated or changed by provisioning. Normal main CMS/intake connection is preserved; reviewer writes go to isolated stores. Functional writes during verification use isolated QA.
production_safety.schema_migration: Idempotent review-only DDL is applied only to bayada_korea_reviews or a validated bayada_preview_<hash> DB, never bayada.
external_side_effects: Deploy Korea main and its renewal preview separately on existing AWS, preserving other app containers. Reuse existing reviewer password without logging it. Add daily private review DB dumps with 14-day retention. No external messages or paid resources.

verification.command: pnpm --filter korea build; pnpm --filter korea typecheck; pnpm --filter admin typecheck
verification.evidence: Next routes and standalone assets build successfully; output/korea-review-build.log.
9 API workflow checks pass on guarded local QA; output/korea-review-integration.json.
Unlock, element selection/save, refreshed list and mobile layout pass; reviewed screenshots in output/korea-review-qa-*.png.

verification.command: python -m unittest discover -s deploy/ec2 -p test_preview.py; py_compile
verification.evidence: 7 deployment/DDL safety checks pass and deployment helpers compile.

residual_risks: Korea and renewal reviews are intentionally separate from brand/academy and from each other; their front-end review lists show their own records.
Review schema retains the existing API soft-delete and status-transition behavior; it does not create a new enterprise audit system.
Shared-password reviewers can view the comments for that site. Access remains separate across hosts and signing secrets.
